code:
g++ -g -O0 demo.cpp -o demo
valgrind --leak-check=full --track-origins=yes ./demo
# For AddressSanitizer (faster, catches more):
g++ -g -fsanitize=address,undefined demo.cpp -o demo_asan && ./demo_asan
description: These commands show two ways to check the demo's memory use. You are reading build and diagnostic commands, not recorded program output.

steps.description: The first command builds demo.cpp with debug information and optimization disabled.
Valgrind runs the demo with full leak checking and origin tracking enabled.
The final command builds with address and undefined-behavior sanitizers. The && operator runs the resulting program after a successful build.

title: Read memory-checking commands
